newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber profits rise.

text.p: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber posted a pre-tax profit of 102 million yuan in the first eight months of 1996, up 89 percent from the same 1995 period, the Shanghai Securities newspaper said on Friday.
In the first seven months, it reduced total costs by 34.05 million yuan from the same 1995 period, cutting the average cost of a tyre from 214 yuan to 181 yuan, it said.
Higher tyre prices and a drop of about one percent in raw material prices also boosted the company's profit, it said.
In the first half of 1996, the company posted a net profit of 45.9 million yuan, up from 34.988 million in the first half of 1995.
The company posted a net profit of 7.92 million yuan for all of 1995.
Tyre & Rubber went into the black in March 1996 after suffering a loss of 32 million yuan in the first two months of 1996, the newspaper said, without giving further details.
The company had been hit by higher prices for natural and synthetic rubber in 1994 and 1995 and a heavy interest burden.
